package.description: Sequential file renamer for images and videos

en-US.description: Sequential file renamer for images and videos
en-US.longDescription:
A fast, minimal desktop app to sequentially rename images and videos.
Select a folder, preview before and after names, set a starting number,
and rename — all reversible with one click undo.
en-US.name: Renamo Lite
